# Tests that CI deselects because they read private research records that are not in the
# repository (git-ignored docs/reports and local artifacts). They are acceptance tests of the
# readiness gates and run in full on the researcher's machine, where they pass (see
# docs/REPRODUCING.md). One entry per test function; a parametrized function is deselected as a
# whole. CI checks that exactly 22 test cases are deselected.
